svg.title: Four robot architectures
svg.desc: Four panels side by side, each standing on a gray bar labeled World. Panel 1: Sense, Model, Plan, Act in a loop: the world feeds Sense, Sense feeds Model, Model feeds Plan, Plan feeds Act, and Act changes the world. Panel 2: Sense feeds a Rule that acts on the world directly; a dashed empty box reads no model, no plan. Panel 3: three behavior boxes, Level 0, Level 1 and Level 2, all fed by the sensors; the output of Level 1 and of Level 2 each enters a circle marked S on the output line of Level 0, which drives the world. Panel 4: three stacked boxes, Deliberative, Executive and Reactive, with arrows going down on the left and up on the right, and the Reactive box connected to the world.
